channel.title: Hartford Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hartford Business Journal (hartfordbusiness.com)

item.title: Last Run for Eversource’s Longtime Lead Snowmaker for Special Olympics Winter Games
item.description: From a winter thaw to last-minute storms to this year’s brutal arctic blast, Andy Ouellette has seen it all in his 24 years of volunteering to make snow for the Special Olympics Connecticut Winter Games.

item.title: Public Health Committee advances bill banning hospital sale-leasebacks
item.description: The legislature’s Public Health Committee has advanced a bill that would restrict certain private equity practices in Connecticut hospitals, including banning sale-leaseback agreements.

item.title: As dairy farms disappear in CT, a coalition of farmers asks state for $20M in aid
item.description: In an effort to stem further losses of dairy farms in the state, a coalition of dairy farmers is lobbying the General Assembly to pass legislation this year to provide stability for the industry.

item.title: Office supplies distributor Uline begins hiring for Plainfield hub
item.description: Wisconsin-based Uline is hiring more than 200 employees for its newest warehouse in Plainfield, saying operations will begin in July.

item.title: 🔒 UConn plans $581M bond sale to fund capital projects, refinance debt
item.description: The University of Connecticut is preparing to bring nearly $581 million in bonds and notes to market next week to fund campus construction projects and refinance older debt.

item.title: 🔒 Nassau Financial Group takes equity stakes in 2 insurtech startups
item.description: Hartford-based financial services firm Nassau Financial Group has taken equity stakes in two insurtech startups — a Connecticut asset management technology company and a genomics-based health navigation firm.

item.title: 🔒 Unions, Democratic lawmakers back worker retention bill; CBIA opposes
item.description: Labor unions and several Democratic lawmakers on Tuesday urged passage of legislation that would require incoming contractors to temporarily retain workers when service contracts change hands, arguing it would prevent abrupt job losses.

item.title: Charter wins PURA approval for Cox deal, pledges to maintain CT HQ
item.description: A state regulator on Tuesday approved Charter Communications Inc.’s acquisition of Cox Communications Inc.’s Connecticut subsidiaries, clearing a major state hurdle for a deal that would create the nation’s largest cable and broadband provider by subscriber count.

item.title: Avon financial adviser indicted on fraud charges tied to $3.3M ‘free-riding’ scheme
item.description: An Avon investment adviser who previously founded an autism-focused financial planning firm has been indicted on federal fraud charges stemming from an alleged scheme that cost three financial services companies more than $3.3 million.
